question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

Her intricate (1)_______ displayed delicate strokes, bold colours and a captivating (2)_______, making it one of the most impressive pieces in the (3)_______.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "composition" refers to the arrangement of elements in an artwork, making it the most appropriate choice for describing the structure of the work.
 
• "Painting" refers to the artwork itself. Hence, "painting" fits best in the first blank. 
 
• "Composition" describes the way the artist arranged its elements. Hence, "Composition" fits best in the second blank.
 
• "Gallery" is the space where artwork is displayed, making it the correct fit for the third blank.
 
• The other options do not logically fit the context of an art piece, as they place the terms in incorrect order.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Her intricate painting__ displayed delicate strokes, bold colours and a captivating __composition__, making it one of the most impressive pieces in the __gallery__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Composition (संरचना)**: Refers to the arrangement or structure of elements in a work of art.
 
• **Painting (चित्रकला)**: The artwork itself, often referring to the medium used by the artist.
 
• **Gallery (गैलरी)**: A space or room where artwork is displayed for the public to view.
